scope_note: Selected source-led civil, property/account, representative-authority and conditional housing/protection forms, including published language variants. Original family placeholders, omitted-family screen and explicit per-form exclusions are reconciled; no English-only scope exclusion. Translation identity is selected without asserting translation-specific effective dates or filing/service sufficiency.

family_selection_reasoning.APP: Appeal and writ procedure for limited and unlimited residential civil disputes, including record, fees, service and costs.
family_selection_reasoning.AT: Prejudgment attachment and exemption process where a covered account claim permits attachment; no assumption that every debt qualifies.
family_selection_reasoning.CIV: General civil pleadings, representation, protected-party authority, judgment, debt collection and property-lien procedure applicable conditionally to covered residential disputes.
family_selection_reasoning.CM: General civil case management, stays, service and settlement of covered residential disputes.
family_selection_reasoning.DISC: Civil discovery, construction-work evidence, account evidence and unlawful-detainer discovery.
family_selection_reasoning.EJ: Recognition, execution, exemptions, consumer-debt procedure, satisfaction and renewal of judgments arising from covered residential disputes.
family_selection_reasoning.FW: Court fee waivers and associated review, including wards, conservatees and appeals.
family_selection_reasoning.MC: General civil filing, costs, representation, access, privacy and protected-person settlement dependencies; selected leaves already recovered in supplement.
family_selection_reasoning.PLD: Contract, common counts, fraud, property damage, premises liability and related tort pleading for residential performance/account disputes. Vehicle and product allegations are conditional mechanisms of covered property damage, not a separate transport or product business.
family_selection_reasoning.POS: Civil service and proofs, including electronic and substituted service.
family_selection_reasoning.SC: Small-claims filing, party authority, service, hearing, judgment, appeal/writ and enforcement of covered residential accounts.
family_selection_reasoning.SUBP: Civil evidence process, including premises inspection, records and interstate discovery for covered disputes.
family_selection_reasoning.UD: Eviction complaint, answer, trial, settlement, judgment, rental-assistance verification and habitability/partial-eviction attachments.
family_selection_reasoning.ADR: Civil mediation, judicial/contractual arbitration and referee procedure for covered residential disputes.
family_selection_reasoning.CH: Civil harassment protection affecting property access, occupant contact and performance of residential work; retains ancillary service, confidentiality, variation and compliance documents.
family_selection_reasoning.DV: Domestic-violence protection affecting possession, contact, access and protected household members; retains ancillary process and compliance, excludes independent custody/parentage, treatment-program and wireless-account administration.
family_selection_reasoning.EA: Elder/dependent-adult protection and contact rights affecting occupancy, property/account authority and access; includes associated process and compliance.
family_selection_reasoning.WV: Workplace-violence protection where covered premises/work create the workplace; retains associated service, variation and compliance rather than unrelated employment litigation.
family_selection_reasoning.TH: Transitional-housing misconduct proceedings and operative instructions for the conditional covered housing regime.
family_selection_reasoning.DE: Decedent authority, estate property, creditor claims, transfer and residence succession affecting ownership, notices, performance authority and payment/refund recipient.
family_selection_reasoning.GC: Existing or proposed guardian/conservator authority, residence/property control, claim notices and fiduciary accounting of covered residential property/accounts; excludes independent custody, medical treatment and immigration administration.
family_selection_reasoning.FL: Property/financial disclosure, property orders, judgment evidence, service, joinder, representation and guardian-ad-litem authority needed when a residential asset/account is subject to family-court control. Not a general divorce, custody, parentage or support proceeding.
family_selection_reasoning.CLETS: Law-enforcement identification supporting protective orders that affect access, contact and occupancy.
family_selection_reasoning.DAL: Construction-related access litigation where covered public-facing residential facilities are implicated; no automatic applicability to every residential unit.
family_selection_reasoning.INT: Civil language access and qualifications of interpreters used in proceedings.
family_selection_reasoning.JUD: General civil judgment form governing adjudicated account resolution.
family_selection_reasoning.MIL: Servicemember petitions and orders relieving financial obligations can affect residential rent and recovery.
family_selection_reasoning.CP: Prejudgment or postjudgment claims of possession by occupants in eviction proceedings.
family_selection_reasoning.SER: Sheriff service and execution instructions across residential dispute and recovery remedies.
family_selection_reasoning.SUM: Commencing civil, eviction, joint-debtor and State Housing Law proceedings; summons attachments and lost summons.
family_selection_reasoning.VL: Prefiling restrictions and their variation govern access to courts in residential disputes.
family_selection_reasoning.EPO: Emergency protective orders affecting occupancy, contact and protected household members.
family_selection_reasoning.RA: Remote participation in civil proceedings, objections and court orders.
family_selection_reasoning.WG: Judgment recovery, protected earnings, exemption hearings and stays; includes financial-abuse garnishment conditionally where a covered residential account dispute produces that judgment.
family_selection_reasoning.CD: Claim-and-delivery remedies for residential personal property; distinct from unlawful-detainer possession.
family_selection_reasoning.EFS: Electronic filing, consent, exemption and service in civil cases.
family_selection_reasoning.ADOPT: Independent adoption/parentage establishment; existing representative authority and protected-minor civil representation are selected through GC/CIV/FL.
family_selection_reasoning.BMD: Independent vital-record correction/establishment, not residential work/account procedure.
family_selection_reasoning.CARE: Respondent rights, existing CARE order changes, notice and related-proceeding information where a covered housing arrangement depends on an existing CARE plan; independent clinical initiation/evaluation is excluded.
family_selection_reasoning.CR: Victim restitution recovery/credit against covered property losses and operative criminal protective-order/termination documents affecting occupancy/contact; no independent prosecution procedure.
family_selection_reasoning.EJT: Mandatory/voluntary expedited civil trial procedure, opt-out, agreements and orders in covered residential disputes.
family_selection_reasoning.EM: Minor emancipation changes capacity to contract and administer residential accounts; retain authority proceedings and financial showing, not DMV licensing.
family_selection_reasoning.GDC: Conditional gender-based pricing discrimination notice for covered work/services; not a generic all-defendants advisory.
family_selection_reasoning.GV: Firearm-only restraining orders; selected CH/DV/EA/WV/SV protections cover occupancy/contact orders rather than independent gun-possession adjudication.
family_selection_reasoning.HC: Custody/habeas and criminal postconviction proceeding, not residential civil recovery or authority process.
family_selection_reasoning.ICWA: Indian child-welfare proceedings rather than residential property/account operation; this is not a tribal housing exclusion.
family_selection_reasoning.JURY: Civil and expedited-jury selection procedure in covered litigation; no independent juror sanctions or criminal jury process.
family_selection_reasoning.JV: Juvenile dependency/delinquency proceedings; existing civil authority/protection documents selected separately.
family_selection_reasoning.LA: Language assistance for court-ordered services and requests/orders to change inaccessible court requirements; preserve conditions affecting compliance.
family_selection_reasoning.MD: Dangerous-dog premises safety proceedings can determine lawful access, animal conditions and safety-related work at covered property.
family_selection_reasoning.NC: Independent name/gender identity-change proceeding; an existing identity record may be evidence without initiating this proceeding.
family_selection_reasoning.RC: Receiver appointment and rents/issues/profits authority determine who may direct property work and collect/pay residential accounts.
family_selection_reasoning.REC: Preserving/accessing court records that establish covered judgments, orders and authority; notice, transfer and retention procedures.
family_selection_reasoning.RT: Retail crime protection concerns retail premises/crime operations, not the covered residential premises workflow.
family_selection_reasoning.SH: Safe at Home protected-party identity and sealing procedure applies to covered civil proceedings and notices.
family_selection_reasoning.SUR: Gestational carrier/parentage proceeding, not residential property/account operation.
family_selection_reasoning.SV: School-violence protection where covered campus/student housing or associated residential work is implicated; all related procedural forms retained conditionally.
family_selection_reasoning.TR: Traffic adjudication, not covered physical property work or residential account.

resolver_contract: The record URL plus local #language=<publisher English language name> selector identifies a concrete form-language pair. Fetch the record without fragment; select the unique anchor labeled Get form <base ID> in <language name>, allowing a matching parenthetical language display suffix; follow its actual href. Reject missing/ambiguous language, do not fallback to English, and require PDF. Deduplicate only by actual shared PDF identity while retaining all form aliases and language applicability.
